title: Dual-energy, high-energy X-ray linear accelerator
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE RESEARCH LABORATORY
detail_text: The government intends to procure 1 each dual-energy Varex Linatron M6A from VJ Technologies to include: one each internal collimator, one each low leackage x-ray head, one set of spare parts, one laser for alignment, one compact RF unit, one modulator/power distribution cabinet, one power line conditioner, one (set) of system cables and hoses, two each M-Series Operator Reference Guides, factory buy off, linatron connection guidance and commissioning assistance, external signal interface, control console, standard spare parts package, system verification summary and test summary included.
